title: knitCompanion Counter Session Weekly Knit Time Trend
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=knitcompanion:counter knit_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(knit_minutes) as avg_duration, max(knit_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst knit time for knitCompanion counter session events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture knit_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average knit time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether knitCompanion counter session tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
